rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for yearning for a particular part of the past.

example.english: My nostalgia for the flat I lived in as a child is still strong.
example.traditional: 我對細個住嗰間屋嘅懷念，到而家仲好深。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 sai3 go3 zyu6 go2 gaan1 uk1 ge3 waai4 nim6 dou3 ji4 gaa1 zung6 hou2 sam1

rows.note: Use this more formal phrase when describing a general nostalgic mood or sentiment rather than longing for one specific thing.

example.english: This exhibition is full of nostalgia and reminds people of old Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 呢個展覽充滿懷舊情懷，令人諗起昔日香港。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 zin2 laam5 cung1 mun5 waai4 gau6 cing4 waai4 ling6 jan4 nam2 hei2 sik1 jat6 hoeng1 gong2
